Formulas.Description: A freightable colony support crate: power, roads, utilities, housing, and a small warehouse. An empty colony mounts this to get its first storage. The site template is the heavier twin and stores nothing.

Properties.Name: Support Colonists
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Population supported when the gravity and atmosphere of the body fall within tolerance. Out-of-tolerance bodies receive no support from this design.'

Properties.Name: Storage Amount
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'The amount of space that is dedicated to storage space. '

Properties.Name: Support Capacity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Support capacity each unit of this infrastructure provides to the colony. Other installations consume this capacity; if demand exceeds supply all colony output is reduced. Only counts on bodies within the gravity and pressure tolerances below.'

Properties.Name: Min Gravity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Surface gravity range (m/s²) this infrastructure can operate in. Earth standard is 9.81 m/s². Drag the left/right handles to set the bounds; drag the bar between them to shift the whole range.'

Properties.Name: Max Gravity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Upper bound of the gravity operating range. Configured via the Min Gravity range slider.'

Properties.Name: Min Pressure
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Atmospheric pressure range (Earth atmospheres) this infrastructure can operate in. Drag the handles to set the bounds; drag the bar between them to shift the whole range.'

Properties.Name: Max Pressure
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Upper bound of the pressure operating range. Configured via the Min Pressure range slider.'

Properties.Name: Sensor Signature
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Placeholder emission so a colony can be picked up by the starting passive sensor. Not balanced.'

Formulas.Description: Site-built colony support. Assembled in place. The gravity and pressure windows are the same width as the prefab, on a track that runs the full range, so a site can be aimed at any body a prefab can. Cost rises as the window moves away from Earth. It does not store cargo. The prefab crate is what gives an empty colony its first warehouse.

Properties.Name: Support Colonists
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Population supported when the gravity and atmosphere of the body fall within tolerance. Out-of-tolerance bodies receive no support from this design.'

Properties.Name: Support Capacity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Support capacity each unit of this infrastructure provides to the colony. Other installations consume this capacity; if demand exceeds supply all colony output is reduced. Only counts on bodies within the gravity and pressure tolerances below.'

Properties.Name: Min Gravity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Surface gravity range (m/s²). The track runs from 0 to 100. The window is the same width as the prefab. Drag the handles or the bar.'

Properties.Name: Max Gravity
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Upper bound of the gravity operating range.'

Properties.Name: Min Pressure
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Atmospheric pressure range (Earth atmospheres). The track runs from 0 to 10. The window is the same width as the prefab.'

Properties.Name: Max Pressure
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Upper bound of the pressure operating range.'

Properties.Name: Hostility
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Cost multiplier. Earth-centered is about 1. A window far from 9.81 m/s² and 1 atm costs more.'
Properties.PropertyFormula: 1 + Abs((PropertyValue('Min Gravity') + PropertyValue('Max Gravity')) / 2 - 9.81) / 9.81 + Abs((PropertyValue('Min Pressure') + PropertyValue('Max Pressure')) / 2 - 1)

Properties.Name: Sensor Signature
Properties.DescriptionFormula: 'Placeholder emission so a colony can be picked up by the starting passive sensor. Not balanced.'
